message.content: Help me obtain a list of new home products that contain 'LED TV' in their product name, have a recommendation status of 1, and want to retrieve the third page of results with 20 items per page?

function.name: SmsHomeNewProductServiceImpl_list
function.description: Retrieves a list of SmsHomeNewProduct entities based on the provided product name, recommendation status, and pagination settings. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

productName.description: The name of the product to filter by, using a 'like' search pattern. This is Java String type parameter in string representation.

recommendStatus.description: The recommendation status to filter by. This is Java integer type parameter in string representation.

pageSize.description: The number of items to return per page. This is Java integer type parameter in string representation.

pageNum.description: The page number to retrieve. This is Java integer type parameter in string representation.
